title: Welcome to Arizona!
fact: Arizona became the 48th state in 1912. Its flag has a copper star in the middle!

title: The Arizona Flag
fact: Color the flag: red and gold rays, a copper star and a blue field. The 13 rays shine like a desert sunset!

title: Yuma
fact: Yuma is called the sunniest city on Earth by Guinness World Records!

title: Lake Havasu City
fact: London Bridge was brought here from England and rebuilt in 1971!

title: Kingman
fact: Kingman sits on one of the longest stretches of old Route 66 left in America!

title: Williams
fact: Williams has a train that rides 65 miles to the Grand Canyon!

title: Grand Canyon Village
fact: The Grand Canyon is more than a mile deep!

title: Page
fact: Near Page, the Colorado River curves into a giant horseshoe at Horseshoe Bend!

title: Flagstaff
fact: Pluto was discovered at Flagstaff's Lowell Observatory in 1930!

title: Sedona
fact: Sedona is famous for its glowing red rock towers!

title: Prescott
fact: Prescott was Arizona's first territorial capital, starting in 1864!

title: Holbrook
fact: Near Holbrook, the Petrified Forest has wood that turned into colorful stone!

title: Payson
fact: Payson holds a big rodeo every August with cowboys and cowgirls!

title: Phoenix
fact: Phoenix is named for a bird that rises from its ashes, and old Hohokam canals once watered the valley!

title: Scottsdale
fact: Scottsdale has Taliesin West, a desert home and school designed by Frank Lloyd Wright!

title: Tempe
fact: Tempe Town Lake was made by building dams on the Salt River!

title: Mesa
fact: Mesa is one of Arizona's biggest cities, and "mesa" means "table" in Spanish!

title: Casa Grande
fact: Near Casa Grande, a huge building built by ancient desert people still stands!

title: Tucson
fact: Saguaro National Park near Tucson protects giant saguaro cacti that can live 150 to 200 years!

title: Sierra Vista
fact: Sierra Vista is called the Hummingbird Capital of the United States!

title: Tombstone
fact: Tombstone is called "The Town Too Tough to Die" and still looks like the Old West!

title: Bisbee
fact: In Bisbee, visitors can ride into the old Queen Mine wearing a hard hat and headlamp!

title: My Family's Town
fact: My family is from ________. Draw your family inside the frame!

title: Goodbye, Arizona!
fact: Scout visited 20 towns across Arizona. Which was your favorite?
